Chapter 6459: Pinnacle Of The Saber

Chapter 6459: Pinnacle Of The Saber

Goldblade and Virtuoso were among the strongest emperors in Gold Village, only behind the golden lords.

Their powers suppressed the whole territory around Octagon, causing all living beings to tremble in fear.

Those in Octagon were affected the most, feeling utterly insignificant due to the arrival of the apex emperors.

Evilsurge thought he could contend against Goldblade alone. However, one against two was hopeless.

Both Goldblade and Virtuoso landed before Li Qiye.

“Young Noble.” Goldblade kneeled.

“Sir.” Virtuoso kneeled.

The crowd gasped upon seeing this. Their teeth chattered as they realized the situation, no longer having the courage to stare at Li Qiye.

In their eyes, Black Wind Monarch was unreachable enough. However, two apex emperors displayed their reverence toward Li Qiye in public.

The apex level was virtually unreachable for cultivators. Thus, who was this ordinary youth? A primal ancestor?

The problem was apex ancestors didn’t need to kneel before primal ancestors. Evilsurge’s expression changed entirely.

“Brother Evilsurge, looks like it is not your lucky day today.” Goldblade stood up and laughed, still having the demeanor of a bandit with devious intention.

“Let’s call this a day.” Evilsurge turned to leave since time was of the essence.

“Clank!” However, a zither flick blocked his path.

“It’s too late to leave now, Brother.” Goldblade said before roaring: “Saber’s Pinnacle!”

He swung his blade into the air and the laws of the tree behind him erupted, morphing into golden sabers.

They converged into his physical blade, culminating in dragon roars before the ultimate slash.

“Damn!” Just a remnant energy wave would obliterate the whole town.

“I’m not afraid of you two!” Evilsurge fused the golden energy with his devilish flames.

“Evil Surge!” This created a maelstrom as he shouted.

“Rumble!” Debris flew everywhere as the maelstrom became more violent.

The slash struck the maelstrom directly, causing considerable damage to the surroundings. Cracks appeared in space and on the ground, painting an apocalyptic scene.

The two were evenly matched. Goldblade had improved dramatically after going to Gold Village since he was only at the half-step level in reality. Here, he could fight against an actual apex emperor.

“Net.” Virtuoso gently flicked his zither, forming a dome made out of a silk-like net.

Evilsurge knew escaping was the prudent choice instead of fighting a hopeless battle.

“Flash Destruction.” He murmured and numerous shadows appeared.

They rushed toward Virtuoso and Goldblade, aiming for their vulnerable spots with daggers.

The two assumed a defensive pose to deal with the clones. This gave enough time for Evilsurge to soar into the air and escape.

Alas, a seal appeared behind him. He reacted quickly and focused the golden laws on his back.

“Bam!” Its primal power penetrated his golden laws and smashed him.

He fell back to the ground while vomiting blood. When he looked up, he saw a girl wearing a violet imperial robe. Her tree towered above the rest.

“Luosha Devil Emperor!” Her appearance shook the crowd to the core.

She completely dominated him with both her primal anima and golden power.
